title: Indian Contract Act, 1872 — Section 198 (Knowledge requisite for valid ratification)

content.overview: No valid ratification can be made by a person whose knowledge of the facts of the case is materially defective.
content.glance: Valid ratification requires knowledge of the material facts; materially defective knowledge bars ratification.
content.study: No valid ratification can be made by a person whose knowledge of the facts of the case is materially defective. Ratification must be an informed election.

sections.heading: Knowledge of material facts
sections.body: Person must not have materially defective knowledge of the facts of the case.

sections.heading: Otherwise no valid ratification
sections.body: Materially defective knowledge prevents valid ratification.

questionsAndAnswers.question: How should a Section 198 problem be analysed?
questionsAndAnswers.answer: Test the ratifier’s knowledge of material facts; if materially defective, deny valid ratification.
